title: Jacobian Rank Collapse in Decision-Focused Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors through downstream objectives, but a different loss need not provide an independent parameter-update direction. We characterize this restriction through the predictor Jacobian, using sparse index tracking to distinguish the covariance entries read by the optimizer from the parameter directions available to learning. Rank-one Jacobians make nonzero per-example gradients collinear; a conditional spectral bound describes near-collinearity. A batch-subspace characterization and counterexamples show why these local statements imply neither common minimizers nor collinear batch updates.   Experiments examine when geometry translates into decision quality. Across 38 one-parameter equity configurations, DFL gains over MSE remain below 1.8%; a 385-parameter conditional predictor also has pointwise rank one. translated_title: 决策聚焦学习中的雅可比秩坍缩
translated_abstract: 决策聚焦学习（DFL）通过下游目标来训练预测器，但不同的损失函数未必能提供独立的参数更新方向。我们通过预测器的雅可比矩阵来刻画这一限制，并以稀疏指数跟踪问题为例，区分优化器所读取的协方差条目与学习过程可用的参数方向。秩一雅可比矩阵会使非零的逐样本梯度共线，而条件谱界则刻画了近乎共线的情形。批次子空间表征与反例说明，为何这些局部性论断既不意味着存在共同的极小值点，也不意味着批次更新必然共线。实验考察了这种几何结构何时会转化为决策质量：在38个单参数股票配置中，DFL相对于MSE的提升始终低于1.8%；一个385参数的条件预测器同样具有逐点秩一的特性。在经验证集调优的最短路径和背包实验中，全容量的SPO+……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了决策聚焦学习中的雅可比秩坍缩现象——当预测器雅可比矩阵为秩一时，逐样本梯度趋于共线，不同损失无法提供独立的参数更新方向，实验表明此时DFL相对MSE的性能提升十分有限。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies Jacobian rank collapse in decision-focused learning—rank-one Jacobians make per-example gradients collinear so that different losses fail to provide independent parameter-update directions, and experiments show DFL's gains over MSE remain marginal in such cases.
